units: pixels (x right, y down, origin top-left) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.evidence: phase correlation of wall patch (x100-700, y350-650) vs frame 0: |shift| < 0.03 px in every frame (columns bg_dx, bg_dy in tracks/ball.csv)
camera.view: front view of a gym wall with a basketball backboard; floor seen slightly from above at the bottom (wall/floor junction y~981). Ball moves purely vertically in a plane facing the camera.

objects.name: ball
objects.description: crimson/magenta basketball with dark seams; the only moving object
objects.reference_point: circle-fit centre (cx, cy) of the ball silhouette = ball origin
objects.x_note: constant to +/-0.2 px: no horizontal motion

objects.name: backboard
objects.description: white rectangular backboard, top centre of image

objects.name: backboard_square
objects.description: orange-red outlined rectangle (shooter's square) painted on the backboard

objects.name: rim
objects.description: orange hoop ring below the square (seen nearly edge-on, as a flat ellipse)

objects.name: net
objects.description: dark mesh net hanging below the rim

objects.name: backboard_support_frame
objects.description: black U-shaped bracket under the backboard

objects.name: wall_upper
objects.description: light grey textured wall, y 0 to ~679

objects.name: wall_teal_band
objects.description: teal/green lower wall band (wainscot) from y~679 to y~981 across the full width

objects.name: floor
objects.description: orange wooden court floor, y>~981; white baseline along the wall at y~989-991 and white court lines (slanted near x~100, x~590, x~1390, x~1850 at the bottom edge); orange light reflections/glare at x~1480 and on the upper right wall are lighting, not objects

objects.name: ball_shadow
objects.description: soft dark shadow on the floor/wall below the ball, most visible near the bounce (frames ~20-28)
objects.note: excluded from the ball mask (low saturation)

events.event: start of motion / release from rest (apex)
events.note: parabola fit to frames 0-22 puts apex at frame 0.01; ball falls straight down from rest
lowest measured centre y=1004.24 at frame 24; parabola branches intersect at frame 23.995 (y~1010.8). Descent before, ascent after.
